Club pays for a coaching tool · adjacent platform

Sics

SICS S.r.l., Soccerment Group · Bassano del Grappa (Vicenza), Italy · founded 1995 · acquired · www.sics.it · last verified 2026-09-19

Club pays for a coaching toolSoftware onlyEvidence A€500 to €2,000 to startAdjacent platformIntegrated into Soccerment since March 2025

Sics is the Bassano del Grappa match analysis house behind VideoMatch and LiveTag, used by Serie A staffs since 1995, now part of Soccerment Group and sold to amateur coaches from EUR 80 a month with Veo Cam 3 as its recommended automatic camera sics-01, sics-02, sics-03.

For Italian professional and semi-professional technical staffs first, and since the Personal edition, amateur and youth coaches who want the same tagging, playlist and drawing tools on footage from a Veo or any other camera sics-02, sics-03. It suits clubs that treat the camera as an input and want an Italian-language analysis workflow with local support sics-01, sics-04.

Sics exists because Italian coaching culture wanted detailed video tagging before automated cameras existed, and the company built a 30-year client list from Inter to the Italian federation on that demand sics-01. It matters now because Soccerment absorbed it in 2025 with Azimut Libera Impresa money, launched SICS Atlas in August 2026 as an AI-native platform, and positions Veo as the capture front end, which makes Sics the analysis layer most likely to sit on top of automated match video in Italy sics-03, sics-04, sics-05. It tells you that in Italy the analysis software vendor, with EUR 1.1 million revenue and seven staff, is a small but strategically placed node that every camera vendor selling into Italian clubs will need to integrate with sics-05, sics-06.

Price band VideoMatch Personal EUR 80/month or EUR 660/year; Pro EUR 99/month or EUR 890/year; Team edition on quotation; Veo camera sold separately sics-02

Italy Sics is an Italian company whose site shows Inter, Juventus, Milan, Roma, Napoli, Atalanta and the Italian federation as clients, with Veo Cam 3 integrated into VideoMatch for automatic recording sics-01, sics-03.

Scale, company-stated

Sics stated partnerships with the technical staffs of more than 150 professional clubs at the March 2025 integration sics-04. Soccerment Group stated in August 2026 that its data covers 310+ competitions, 90,000+ players, 6,500 new matches with video per month and operations in 50+ countries sics-05.

2025 and 2026

  • 2025-03-25: Soccerment and Sics combine to form an Italian football AI group, backed by Azimut Libera Impresa sics-04.
  • 2026-08-20: Soccerment Group launches SICS Atlas, an AI-native platform for match analysis and scouting sics-05.

Not verified

  • Team edition pricing for multi-team clubs.
  • Whether the Veo integration covers live analysis yet, since the page marks it as coming soon.
  • The legal structure of the Soccerment transaction, whether SICS S.r.l. survives as a subsidiary or was merged.
  • The number of amateur and youth clubs on VideoMatch Personal.
